desc:
🕯️Use the tools at your disposal to hunt down and identify the evil spirits haunting your jobsite!

👁️ For the best experience, play with max graphic settings!
🎵 Demonology's music is custom & copyright free, feel free to use it in videos!

⚠️ Disclaimer: This game contains loud noises, flashing lights, and visual elements that may trigger trypophobia or claustrophobia.

💝 Made with love by Blaqk Magic

badges.name: You're Hired!
badges.desc:
Welcome to Demonology Solutions! We're happy to have you here! Lucky for you, our employee mortality is at an all time low of 30%!

- Earn this badge by playing Demonology for the first time!

badges.name: First Paycheck
badges.desc:
You're a natural! Congrats on your first successful job, here's to many more!

- Earn this badge by correctly identifying the ghost for the first time

badges.name: Well, that ain't good
badges.desc:
They can't all be winners, and unfortunately you are now dead, but luckily our EMPLOYEE RESURRECTION PROGRAM(tm) can bring you back to life.

- Earn this badge by dying to the ghost during a job

badges.name: Employee of the Month
badges.desc:
This reward is undoubtedly more special than any kind of jubilee, jamboree, etc etc. Congrats on being our Employee of the Month!

- Earn this badge by playing Demonology again at least a month after your first time!

badges.name: That was scary...
badges.desc:
So, you survived your first ghost hunt. Now look, I know, you're absolutely terrified and are probably wanting to get out of your contract, but please refer to the fine print that explicitly outlines our "NO LEAVING AFTER SURVIVING YOUR FIRST GHOST HUNT" clause.

- Earn this badge by surviving your first ghost hunt on a job

badges.name: Corporate Approval
badges.desc:
Speaking candidly here, most of our employees don't make it past their first job, so the fact that you've "successfully"? completed 10 has shocked all of us here at the corporate office. You certainly have our seal of approval, keep on doing.. whatever it is you're doing, because it's working.

- Earn this badge by identifying the ghost 10 times

badges.name: Gold Star Sticker
badges.desc:
Look, we don't usually plan this far ahead, but, we found this gold star sticker on the backpack of one of our employee's kids, and after we heard you successfully completed your 25th job, we all decided you deserved it more.

- Earn this badge by identifying the ghost 25 times

badges.name: Huge Bonus
badges.desc:
The director wasn't expecting to have to pay you more than 2 jobs worth of a salary, but since you've survived 50 jobs, we thought what the heck, we found this crisp 20 in a Walmart parking lot earlier today and now it's all yours buddy. 

- Earn this badge by identifying the ghost 50 times

badges.name: Spiritualist
badges.desc:
We don't offer training for using the Umbra Board, but it seems like you're a savant with it and we are very lucky to have you here at Demonology Solutions, LLC.

- Earn this badge by communicating with the ghost through an Umbra Board

badges.name: Self Reflection
badges.desc:
Regardless of whether or not you just wanted to stare at yourself in the mirror, you put it all on the line to help your team discover the ghost's whereabouts, and for that we applaud you.

- Earn this badge by using the Haunted Mirror to find the ghost room

badges.name: Virtuoso
badges.desc:
We don't offer extra points for having a good music taste, but we do offer extra points for people who decide they want to take the risk of playing the creepy, haunted looking music box that was mysteriously and somewhat questionably placed in a location directly accessible to anyone entering the room.

- Earn this badge by using the Music Box to locate the ghost

badges.name: Necromancer
badges.desc:
So let me get this straight, you saw a demonic symbol painted on the ground surrounded by blood red candles.. and your first thought was to light the candles? Crazy doesn't even BEGIN to describe that, but it helps our investigation so we're stuck between a rock and a hard place here.

- Earn this badge by using the Summoning Circle to summon the ghost

badges.name: Clairvoyant
badges.desc:
You know how the song goes, 🎶 First you find the coin then you put the coin in the creepy looking Fortune Teller box- actually, you know, I don't think that's how any song goes. Well uh, still, that psychic animatronic seemed to help us along in our investigation, so way to go!

- Earn this badge by giving the Fortune Teller a coin to have your fortune read

badges.name: Detective
badges.desc:
We always knew you had a little bit of that Sherlock Holmes spirit! By now, I'm sure you know that picking up any object that seems remotely cursed will plague you with the memories of some long dead inhuman entity, but you did it anyway. Therapy costs are not included in our Employee Compensation Plan, by the way.

- Earn this badge by using the Magnifying Glass to examine the ghost
